competitors.name: Monash University FODMAP Diet App
competitors.strengths: Gold standard laboratory-tested FODMAP serving thresholds; direct link to Monash research team.
competitors.weaknesses: Clunky non-intuitive UI, basic tracking functionality, lacks holistic lifestyle/stress factors.
competitors.differentiation: IBS Go integrates Monash-backed thresholds directly into an effortless daily symptom & pattern visualizer with mind-gut guidance.

competitors.name: Cara Care
competitors.strengths: Medically certified, comprehensive symptom & stool tracking, prescription-level reimbursement in Germany.
competitors.weaknesses: High barrier to entry outside Germany, complex multi-step logging interface, overwhelming for quick meal checks.
competitors.differentiation: IBS Go offers zero-friction micro-logging and instant static lookup without paywalling basic food safety checks.

competitors.name: Bowelle
competitors.strengths: Beautiful, simple design; visual mood and symptom logs.
competitors.weaknesses: No built-in FODMAP database or food safety lookup; manual typing required for all meals.
competitors.differentiation: IBS Go combines Bowelle's warmth and visual ease with an instant Monash-referenced FODMAP database.

competitors.name: FODMAP Friendly App
competitors.strengths: Independent lab accreditation, exact percentage breakdowns of individual FODMAP types.
competitors.weaknesses: Limited UI polish, minimal symptom correlation or reintroduction planning capabilities.
competitors.differentiation: IBS Go provides step-by-step reintroduction planners and pattern analytics alongside verified serving thresholds.

competitors.name: Nerva by Mindset Health
competitors.strengths: Evidence-backed 6-week gut-brain hypnotherapy program based on Monash trial data.
competitors.weaknesses: Expensive subscription ($60+/mo), no dietary or food logging tools.
competitors.differentiation: IBS Go focuses on dietary protocol management, daily tracking, and trigger detection while acknowledging mind-gut connection.

competitors.name: Fast Tract Diet App
competitors.strengths: Uses Fermentation Potential (FP) system for SIBO and acid reflux.
competitors.weaknesses: Niche framework, steep learning curve, differs from standard Monash FODMAP consensus.
competitors.differentiation: IBS Go adheres strictly to widely accepted Monash, NICE, and ACG low-FODMAP clinical guidelines.

competitors.name: FoodMarble AIRE 2
competitors.strengths: Real-time gas measurement via portable hardware breath test.
competitors.weaknesses: High upfront hardware cost ($249+), breath gas readings can fluctuate based on non-dietary variables.
competitors.differentiation: IBS Go is software-only, accessible instantly on any web browser or mobile phone without proprietary hardware.

clinical_sources.citation: Monash University FODMAP Research Team (2023/2024 updates)
clinical_sources.scope: Laboratory cutoffs for Fructans, GOS, Lactose, Excess Fructose, Sorbitol, and Mannitol per standard serving size.
clinical_sources.application: Drives all food serving green/amber/red thresholds across the IBS Go directory.

clinical_sources.citation: NICE Guidelines CG61: Irritable bowel syndrome in adults (Updated 2021)
clinical_sources.scope: First-line dietary and lifestyle advice (regular meals, fluid intake, restriction of alcohol/caffeine/fiber adjustments) prior to restrictive diets.
clinical_sources.application: Embedded in Protocol Guides and Post-Diagnostic guidance.

clinical_sources.citation: American College of Gastroenterology (ACG) Clinical Guideline: Management of IBS (2021)
clinical_sources.scope: Strong recommendation for limited trial of low-FODMAP diet for global symptom relief in IBS; guidance on gut-directed psychotherapies.
clinical_sources.application: Informs clinical post framing, Mind-Gut integrations, and evidence-level disclosures.

clinical_sources.citation: Rome IV Criteria for Functional Gastrointestinal Disorders (2016)
clinical_sources.scope: Recurrent abdominal pain on average at least 1 day/week in the last 3 months, associated with 2+ criteria (defecation, frequency change, stool form change).
clinical_sources.application: Informs symptom library diagnostic context and red-flag doctor referral triggers.

clinical_sources.citation: British Dietetic Association (BDA) Systematic Review on Low FODMAP Diet (2018)
clinical_sources.scope: Efficacy of low FODMAP diet in clinical practice and the critical requirement for dietitian-led reintroduction.
clinical_sources.application: Drives strict non-restriction policy and reintroduction phase emphasis.
